description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity to provide compatibility with the Leanback library, sets up the UI with a TextView and a ComposeView for rendering the home screen interface. The ComposeView content includes navigation items, a hero section, and multiple rails with card items, including a section for TV channels with progress indicators. The activity also handles remote control key events for navigation and selection.
